normalization_plan.reason: The _owner parameter only carries the new owner address into the ownershipTransfer calldata and has no independent semantic role.
The _emergency parameter is a pure pass-through flag of setCircuitBreaker.
userAddr is only forwarded to the siProxy reward-lane update call.
callerID is only used by rewardUpdateOfInAction to look up the handler address.
handlerID only parameterises the flashloan delegatecall.
amount only parameterises the flashloan delegatecall.
receiverAddress only parameterises the flashloan delegatecall.
delinquentBorrower is only forwarded to the handler liquidation calldata.
callData is the exact payload handed to the slot setter delegatecall and belongs to that unsafe operation.
result is the success flag returned by the slot setter delegatecall and asserted immediately afterwards.
liquidatePrice is an internal scratch value of the reward comparison in getMaxLiquidationReward.
depositCredit is a scratch value only used for the sub/unifiedDiv computation inside _getUserExtraLiquidityAmount.
